evidence: The report lists three always-present visual problems on PowerToys 0.101.2362 but attaches no screenshot or recording.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper reportedly stays white in dark mode, lets preview pixels escape rounded borders, and crops portrait windows into landscape thumbnails.
known_information: The report gives expected and actual behavior and Windows 11 context.
The reporter states PowerToys is running as admin and installed from GitHub.
No screenshot, recording, display scale, monitor arrangement, or exact activation context is supplied.
Current source contains intended implementations for all three visual areas.
inferences: The released behavior may depend on OS build, scaling, monitor geometry, or a path bypassing the intended rendering code.
issue_context.analysis: Because source already expresses the desired behavior, visual evidence is required to locate the mismatch rather than create a speculative design. The existing author-feedback request should stand.
initial_investigation: src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp reads HKCU Personalize AppsUseLightTheme and applies dark/light acrylic tint constants.
src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp draws rounded card/preview regions around DWM thumbnails.
src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycleLogic.h::CoverSource crops wide/tall source rectangles to destination aspect ratio and has unit test coverage.
Targeted duplicate search found no separate Window Hopper visual duplicate or linked fix.
